system.name: Spectre
system.summary: Ecosystem manifest for @phcdevworks/spectre-base — WordPress theme foundation built on the Spectre design system.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.description: Base design-system packages and adapters that higher layers build on.

build.title: Build
build.description: Packages that assemble or consume foundation outputs into deliverable artifacts.

@phcdevworks/spectre-base.description: WordPress theme foundation with Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4 backed by the Spectre design system.
notes: WordPress theme foundation — does not publish a runtime JS/TS API.
Token and styling values come from spectre-tokens and spectre-ui; components from spectre-components.

@phcdevworks/spectre-tokens.description: Design-token source for the Spectre system.

@phcdevworks/spectre-ui.description: Layer 2 styling contract between spectre-tokens and downstream adapters.

@phcdevworks/spectre-components.description: Lit-based web components for the Spectre system.

notes: Foundation packages may depend only on other foundation packages or external libraries.
Build packages may depend on foundation packages or other build packages.

boundaryConstraints.rule: Must not import Spectre packages outside its declared allowedTargets.
boundaryConstraints.reason: spectre-base is a WordPress theme; its Spectre dependency surface is fixed to the declared runtime deps.

generationRules: Run npm run build before running any validation.
Run npm run check before staging any commit — all checks must pass.
Do not hand-edit files in spectre-theme/dist/ — they are generated by the build.
usageGuidance: This package is a WordPress theme foundation; it does not publish a JS/TS API.
Token and styling values come from @phcdevworks/spectre-tokens and @phcdevworks/spectre-ui.
safeDefaults: Do not modify locked color families from spectre-tokens without explicit human approval.
Do not add Spectre runtime dependencies without updating both package.json and spectre.manifest.json.
Do not hand-edit generated theme assets in spectre-theme/dist/.
